div.p: Network Data Blaster streams high-velocity events directly into Splunk via the HTTP Event Collector (HEC). Before launching simulations, ensure HEC is enabled and target indexes are created.

ol.li: Navigate to Settings > Data Inputs > HTTP Event Collector.
Click Global Settings > Set All Tokens to Enabled. Note port (Standard: 8088, Isolated Docker: 8888).
Click New Token: Name: ta_datablaster_hec, select default indexes.
Paste the generated token into the Configuration Screen.

div.h2: 🚀 4. Onboarding Net-New Sample Data & Custom Sourcetypes
div.p: You can easily onboard brand new log samples from proprietary appliances, specialized firewalls, or custom internal applications. The platform provides both a Graphical UI Onboarding Tool and a File-Based Dropzone:

div.h4: Method A: Graphical UI Onboarding Tool

ol.li: Scroll to the "Onboard Net-New Sample Data" section.
Paste your raw log lines into the text area.
Enter the target Sourcetype name (e.g. cisco:custom:waf) and target Index (e.g. idx_security_fw).
Click "Onboard & Blast Sample". The platform saves the sample into samples/, generates props parsing, and immediately indexes the events via HEC!
Drop your raw sample log file into: TA-network-data-blaster/samples/<vendor_sample>.log.
In default/props.conf, define extraction or let auto-KV parse: [vendor:custom:syslog] SHOULD_LINEMERGE = false TIME_PREFIX = ^ MAX_TIMESTAMP_LOOKAHEAD = 32
Use the Data Blaster Console or Single Device Blaster to target the new file and stream immediately!

h2.style: color: #ec4899; font-size: 16px; margin-top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;

div.h2: 📦 5. Technical Add-on (TA) Bundling vs. Production Prerequisites

div.h4: What is Bundled (Out of the Box)

ul.li: 100% Standalone Readiness: The app includes built-in CIM field extractions (Network Traffic, Network Sessions, Performance, Alerts) for all simulated vendors.
Zero External Dependencies: You do not need to install 11 separate vendor TAs just to run the simulations, view the topologies, or see dashboard charts.
Air-Gapped Operation: All vendor libraries, icons, and vector topology graphics are bundled locally.

div.p: If you deploy this synthetic traffic generator in an enterprise Splunk environment with proprietary data models or Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), installing the official Splunkbase companion TAs provides advanced hardware inventory acceleration:

ul.style: margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace; color: #cbd5e1;
ul.li: Splunk_TA_cisco-ios (Cisco IOS / XE)
Splunk_TA_paloalto (Palo Alto Networks Next-Gen FW)
Splunk_TA_fortinet_fortigate (Fortinet FortiOS)
